sloka: सुकेशं धार्मिकं दृष्ट्वा वरलब्धं च राक्षसम् ।ग्रामणीर्नाम गन्धर्वो विश्वावसुसमप्रभः ।। ७.५.१ ॥
transliteration: sukeśaṁ dhārmikaṁ dṛṣṭvā varalabdhaṁ ca rākṣasam ।grāmaṇīrnāma gandharvo viśvāvasusamaprabhaḥ ।। 7.5.1 ॥

translations.english: Having seen Sukesha, the righteous demon who had obtained a boon, a Gandharva named Gramani, whose splendor was like that of Vishvavasu, (approached him).
